capabilities: create Markdown index notes that represent folders in the graph
keep folder links and tables of contents current with a background worker
exclude unwanted vault files from early traversal
refresh native link resolution from the status bar
maintain root and Home navigation for eligible files
extras: Freemium: Free covers filtering, status/recovery and existing links; a one-time-purchase Full tier ($5.70 founders, $8.92 regular) adds automatic folder-index upkeep with a 30-day trial requiring account sign-in and HTTPS checks. Version 1.1.3 supports Windows desktop only; the full guide lives in GUIDE.md, not the README.
intentEvidence: optional folder-note navigation for your existing vault and native graph
problem: Obsidian's native graph and navigation ignore folders as units, and manually written folder index notes go stale as files are added, moved or renamed.

relations.evidence: we recommend using Vault Foundations with Graph Views, also created and maintained by ARCXCOVAEL LLC

summary: Folder-index plugin that creates small Markdown index notes for folders and keeps their links and tables of contents current with a background worker.
